error.suggestion: Re-run a snapshot and retry with a ref from the returned snapshot (CLI: snapshot, then use the printed @<snapshot_id>:eN ref; FFI: ad_snapshot then pass the printed qualified ref to ad_execute_by_ref). Snapshots are scoped to the session that took them, so take the snapshot under the same --session or AGENT_DESKTOP_SESSION you act with: one taken outside a session is not visible to a session-scoped action, and re-running it outside the session will fail the same way
